# NBC News

> > NBC News is a comprehensive news organization providing breaking news, political coverage, and local news from major U.S. markets with video content and live streaming.

NBC News serves as a major news outlet covering national politics, investigations, and local news across key metropolitan areas. The site features coverage of significant political events, obituaries of notable figures, and curated shopping content alongside its core news operations.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Political News
- Local News
- Video News
- Robert Mueller
- Trump-Russia Investigation
- FBI
- Special Counsel
- News Headlines
- Live Streaming
- 2016 Election Interference
- Department of Justice
- NBC Local Stations
- News Tips
- Weather
